Title: Finland – Road transport services – Lohjan kaupungin tilausajot ja muu henkilöliikenne, dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä (DPS) v. 2025 - 2027
Procedure title: Lohjan kaupungin tilausajot ja muu henkilöliikenne, dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä (DPS) v. 2025 - 2027
Description: Lohjan kaupunki pyytää osallistumishakemuksia kuljetuspalveluihin. Hankintailmoituksella perustetaan dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä (DPS). Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksytään kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät ehdokkaat. Järjestelmään ilmoittautuminen ei sido ehdokasta. Ehdokas voi valita, mihin järjestelmän sisällä järjestettäviin kilpailutuksiin osallistuu. Suitable small platform candidates shall be further investigated in terms of its capacity and compliance towards the observational needs, the deorbiting requirements, and its capability to host the identified optical imager. The preliminary technical, engineering and quality assurance requirements for the Delta-Class mission shall be reviewed, agreed and consolidated as part of the Preliminary Requirements Review. The development approach shall be further elaborated with the objective to enable the establishment of the implementation and procurement plan. System optimisations based on previous flight experience that may lead to an improvement of the mission performance and its robustness by enhancing the existing equipment and optical imager may be considered for further elaboration during Phase B1.The Phase B1 industrial system study shall produce a preliminary design of the space and ground segment that shall include all elements for the mission definition, the spacecraft and the optical imager and the ground segment. The satellite design shall be matured, and a detailed accommodation study of the optical imager shall be performed. The design of the optical imager and potential modifications that may be required shall be addressed including the detector selection, readout electronics and the control and data processing unit. The technical requirements specifications of all major units shall be established, and the system requirements shall be consolidated and verified as far as possible by analysis.
